summary: T010 pre-existing implementation (ChainId, Address, Currency, PoolKey, PoolId as frozen dataclass value objects in src/robinhood_lp/protocol/ids.py; canonical ABI encoding in src/robinhood_lp/protocol/abi.py; 7 pinned Solidity-oracle vectors in tests/fixtures/protocol/pool_id_vectors.json covering native currency, static fee 3000, dynamic-fee sentinel 0x800000 with nonzero hook, max static fee 1_000_000, max tick spacing 32_767, hook with delta-action flag bits 0x88, and reordered-inputs) is preserved unchanged. No existing tests were modified; no production code was modified. All four quality commands (pytest, ruff check, ruff format --check, mypy src tests) passed cleanly in two consecutive runs with byte-identical summary lines apart from pytest wall-clock duration (1.72s vs 1.54s).
